data.narrative:
FuriosaAI is a Series C–stage semiconductor company founded by June Paik that has raised $246M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 firms across Chips & Semiconductors—3 public companies (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including same-stage companies Etched, d-Matrix, and DEEPX.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression, using total raised ($246M) as a proxy and applying a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier for Series C advancement, yields $418M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables (Etched at $5.0B, d-Matrix at $2.0B, DEEPX at $529M) implies a median valuation of $2.0B, with a range of $529M to $5.0B. The stage-progression method anchors the lower end, while peer multiples anchor the upper end of the range.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $355M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.2B. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around which peer comparables best reflect FuriosaAI's stage, technology differentiation, and customer traction. The peer-median approach assumes parity with the median of the comp set; stage-progression relies on $246M as a proxy for invested capital rather than explicit post-money valuation at prior rounds. Further diligence on revenue trajectory, unit economics, and go-to-market execution would narrow this band.
